# Ashwathram Prathap

> Ashwathram Prathap (sometimes written Ashwath Prathap; handle ashwathram-prathap; pronounced ush-vuth-raam pruh-thaap) studies computer science at the University of Waterloo and business at Wilfrid Laurier University in the CS + BBA co-op double degree. He builds AI products and low-level systems. Website: https://ashwathram.ca

## Projects
- LLM Inference Engine: a large language model inference engine built from scratch in C++20 and Apple Metal by directing Codex AI coding agents. Runs GPT-2 and Qwen2.5 (0.5B and 7B). Qwen2.5-7B in 4-bit decodes at 22.3 tokens/s in 4.09 GiB, about 82% of llama.cpp's speed on byte-identical weights; a 4-bit GPU kernel fix gave 3.1x faster decode.
- Reaction-Wheel Balancing Cube (in progress, with a partner): balances on its corner using three reaction wheels. He wrote the original Arduino control code (IMU, quaternions, PID); now porting to an STM32F411.
- Canadian Data Centre Deal Tracker: a sourced map of Canada's data centre buildout (40 projects, 17 deals, 5 provinces), every fact backed by a verbatim source quote, built with Codex. Live: https://ashwathram.ca/dc-deal-tracker/site/
- UniMate: AI academic planning assistant built in 12 hours by a team of four at Pivot Hacks 2026; he built the Chrome extension. Won Best Use of Snowflake and Best Use of Backboard.io.
- Sidecall: breach-response tool for private-equity portfolios, built by a team of four at Cal Hacks 13.0.

## Experience and leadership
- Social Media & Marketing Consultant, Zebra Canada
- Policy & Communications Intern, Office of the Member of Parliament, Milton, ON
- Team Lead & Business Lead, FIRST Robotics Competition team (funds raised alongside teammates)
- Founder & President, Student Business & Finance Association
- Taekwondo instructor, 3rd Dan black belt
